settings.opmlHelp: Import opens a file picker to choose an OPML file. Export lets you choose a folder and filename. Import preserves folders and adds subscriptions without downloading stories; press Refresh afterward. Export creates a new file and never overwrites an existing one.
settings.shortcuts:
↑ / ↓ or j / k: select story
Enter / →: open story
← / Escape: close article
s: save / unsave
m: read / unread
o: open in browser
r: refresh current view
/: focus search
Tab / Shift+Tab: next / previous control
Enter / Space: activate focused action
Escape in search: clear, then leave input
?: Settings and this help
Shortcuts are inactive while editing text.
